calculation_handling.description: For a project with a complete site plan application filed on or prior to July 22, 2022, the listed current bicycle parking regulations do not prevent it if it complies with the former Chapter 970 regulations.
calculation_handling.gaps: Site plan application dates are not held; the former Chapter 970 path is never evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: For a project with a complete site plan application filed after July 22, 2022 and on or prior to March 31, 2025, the listed current bicycle parking regulations do not prevent it if it complies with former regulations 970.30.15.5(3), (4) and (5).
calculation_handling.gaps: Site plan application dates are not held; the former Chapter 970 path is never evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Defines a complete application for site plan approval as one meeting Official Plan Policy 5.5.2.

Site plan approval may be granted if the project complies with the former Chapter 970 regulations or By-law 569-2013 as it read on and prior to July 22, 2022, and with Section 114 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
calculation_handling.gaps: The former-rules path is never evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: After site plan approval under (A), a building permit may be issued if the project complies with the former Chapter 970 regulations or By-law 569-2013 as it read then, the site plan approval and approved minor variances.
calculation_handling.gaps: The former-rules path is never evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Site plan approval may be granted if the project complies with former regulations 970.30.15.5(3) and (5) or By-law 569-2013 as it read after July 22, 2022 and on and prior to March 31, 2025, and with Section 114 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
calculation_handling.gaps: The former-rules path is never evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: After site plan approval under (C), a building permit may be issued if the project complies with former regulations 970.30.15.5(3) and (5) or By-law 569-2013 as it read then, the site plan approval and approved minor variances.
calculation_handling.gaps: The former-rules path is never evaluated.

230.90.15.4(1).explanation: Current bicycle parking rules do not block a project with a complete site plan application filed on or before July 22, 2022, as long as it follows the earlier Chapter 970 bicycle parking rules.

230.90.15.4(2).explanation: The same relief applies to a complete site plan application filed after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025, using the earlier Chapter 970 clauses 970.30.15.5(3), (4) and (5).

230.90.15.4(3).explanation: A complete application for site plan approval means one that satisfies Official Plan Policy 5.5.2.

230.90.15.4(4).explanation: For qualifying projects, site plan approval may be granted, and a building permit later issued, if the project follows the earlier Chapter 970 bicycle parking rules or the by-law as it read on the relevant earlier date, plus Section 114 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006 for site plan approval.
